name: Jim Green

prices.note: WooCommerce Store API, category all (118 products, 2 pages): 62 regular-price boots after dropping vellies/shoes, laces, soles and add-ons; 34 items on sale excluded. notes: USA shipping: free standard shipping to the 48 contiguous states on orders of $50+, $30 to Hawaii and Alaska, sent from a warehouse in the USA (https://jimgreenfootwear.com/jim-green-usa-shipping-and-returns/).
Returns: 60-day window, unworn or defective, return or exchange; $10 restocking fee on returns of sale items (same URL).
About: began in a back-yard garage in 1992, Midlands Meander, KwaZulu-Natal; hand crafted in South Africa (https://jimgreenfootwear.com/about-us/).
